title: GitHub workflows: API-driven label/size/review/release-note jobs fetch their script with pinned curl instead of actions/checkout
answers: Why do the labeling, PR size, patch, advice, or team review workflows no longer check out the repo?
How does a workflow get its helper JavaScript file when only the GitHub API is needed?
Where is the release-note validation script downloaded for the validate-labeled and post-merge jobs?
Why did the approval workflow download step change to use GITHUB_REPOSITORY and GITHUB_SHA?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/*.yml for lightweight API-driven jobs (labeling.yml, pr-size.yml, patch.yml, advice.yml, team-review.yml, approval.yml, and both jobs in release-note.yml). Each job's first step fetches one `<name>.js` helper from raw.githubusercontent.com and then runs it via actions/github-script.
Rule: Do not use actions/checkout for these jobs. Use a step named `Fetch script` that runs `curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 --write-out 'curl: %{time_total}s\n'` against `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/$GITHUB_SHA/.github/workflows/<name>.js` and writes to `-o <name>.js` in the workspace root. The github-script step then calls `require('./<name>.js')`. The download is pinned to GITHUB_SHA, so it matches the workflow revision that triggered the run.
Symptom: Jobs that only needed the scripts paid checkout latency, and checkout time occasionally spiked into outliers.
Constraints: Applies to jobs that only call the GitHub API through github-script. Jobs that need the rest of the repository tree, or that run local tooling, still need a checkout. The fetched file is one script only; add any other needed file to the same curl pattern.
applies: GitHub Actions workflows under .github/workflows that drive github-script with a helper file.
says: Speed up pull request labeling and size checks by avoiding full repository downloads.
Automated triage and review assignment checks take too long due to repository cloning.
Why do automated pull request status jobs no longer clone the entire codebase?
Eliminate latency spikes in automated release note validation and pull request review workflows.
search: Lightweight API-driven workflow jobs fetch helper scripts directly via pinned `curl` instead of using `actions/checkout` to eliminate checkout latency. A `Fetch script` step downloads `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/$GITHUB_SHA/.github/workflows/<name>.js` with `--retry 3 --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30` to `-o <name>.js` before calling `actions/github-script` with `require('./<name>.js')`. This applies to `.github/workflows/` jobs like `labeling.yml`, `pr-size.yml`, `patch.yml`, `advice.yml`, `team-review.yml`, `approval.yml`, and `release-note.yml`. Jobs requiring the full repository tree or local tooling still require a checkout.
